mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport authority of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility provider or licensed bank in the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory, documented pre-acceptance screening of every director, shareholder, UBO, and proposed signatory against (i) the Samoa FIU Politically Exposed Persons list, (ii) OFAC SDN list, (iii) UN Consolidated Sanctions List, (iv) EU consolidated financial sanctions, and (v) Interpol red-notice and adverse-media databases. All screening must be independently evidenced in the registered agent's client file, repeated at each transaction trigger, and refreshed on a quarterly basis for a medium-risk enhanced-scrutiny online jewelry and fine timepieces e-commerce profile. A PEP relationship requires written approval by the registered agent's compliance officer, enhanced due diligence, and verified source-of-funds documentation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry name search and reservation facility administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Companies Registry, Apia
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be in English or Latin-script transliteration; Chinese names of shareholders do not form the legal name but may be adopted in the articles in Chinese script as a convenience, provided the principal registered name is expressed in Latin characters, is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, and includes the suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' as required for Samoa International Companies
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 days of a formal refusal, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of Companies at MCIL, Apia, stating grounds of distinctiveness and attaching the certificate of name search. The Registrar will rule within 21 working days; if the appeal is refused, further reconsideration is available from the Chief Executive Officer of MCIL within another 14 days, and an adverse final administrative decision may be challenged by way of judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa. Reservation extensions are permitted only upon an approved Ministerial or Registrar discretion for registered agent filing errors.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The registered office must be a physical office in Samoa maintained by a licensed registered agent. A fully remote virtual-only arrangement is not acceptable; however, a virtual mailbox service layered over the registered agent's physical Apia office is permissible for this e-commerce activity. The company's books and statutory records must remain accessible at the registered agent's address for inspection.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 2% to 5% annual probability for a medium-risk enhanced-scrutiny online jewelry and fine timepieces company. The Registrar and the Samoa FIU may conduct unannounced on-site inspections of the registered agent and company records where payment processing involves PayPal or Stripe aggregators and cross-border watch/jewelry inventory; inspections are more likely where UBO residence or paying jurisdictions are identified as high-risk.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, including its provisions governing incorporation by registration, the constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association), share capital, the registered office, the licensed registered agent, directors, and the conclusive Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Independent State of Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form A - Application for Incorporation of an International Company, accompanied by the company's executed Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Constitution fixes the authorized share capital in any freely convertible currency. There is no escrow deposit or capital-verification requirement under the International Companies Act 1987. Shares may be issued fully or partly paid for such consideration as the directors determine, and bearer shares are prohibited.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the initial subscriber(s) named in the Constitution of WS-IC [Company Name] Ltd do hereby subscribe for and accept the number of shares allotted to them in the register of members, such shares being fully or partly paid as determined by the directors. RESOLVED THAT the registered office of the Company at [address in Apia, Samoa], maintained by the licensed registered agent, be and is hereby adopted, and the registered agent is authorized to receive and file all statutory documents. RESOLVED THAT [name] be and is hereby appointed as initial director and [name] as company secretary, each with full corporate authority to open bank and payment accounts and to transact all business of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa (acting through a licensed Samoa registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name-reservation request to the Registrar of International Companies proposing up to two alternative names in English. The selected name must end with 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing Samoan or international company name, nor contravene the name restrictions under the International Companies Act 1987, such as words implying governmental patronage, criminality, or an impermissible object. The licensed registered agent files the request and the Registrar issues a written name clearance certificate.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form with two alternative names
Copy of the incorporator's passport or certificate of good standing (if corporate incorporator)
Engagement letter of the licensed Samoan registered agent
AML/KYC beneficial ownership questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, the registered agent resubmits revised alternative names within 3 business days; objections based on similarity are cured by adding distinguishable elements such as 'WS', 'Global', or 'Pacific' and obtaining a fresh name clearance certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of the Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent (preparation); Registrar of International Companies (acceptance)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Constitution in English in accordance with the International Companies Act 1987, recording the company name, Samoa registered office, authorized share capital in USD or another currency, share classes and terms, permitted objects covering general e-commerce and holding activities, director and shareholder powers, indemnity provisions, and the election between restricted and unrestricted objects. Each subscriber executes the Constitution; witnesses may sign but notarization is not a statutory condition. The agent certifies compliance and retains certified copies of subscriber identities.
required_dossiers: Draft Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
Subscriber execution pages with witness signatures
Passport copies and proof of address of each subscriber and director
Beneficial ownership statement under the Samoan AML/CFT regime
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registered agent corrects any drafting or compliance defect and re-executes a revised Constitution prior to filing; no penalty is imposed where correction occurs before submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of the Incorporation Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form A together with the executed Constitution, a statutory declaration of compliance, the consent of the registered agent and registered office, and identity documents of the first director and shareholder. Submission is made physically at the Registry in Apia or through the agent's secure electronic channel. The Registrar verifies that the name, constitution, registered office, registered agent, and directors satisfy the Act. The official filing fee of approximately USD 200 is paid at the MCIL cashier or by bank transfer, subject to the current Government Fees Regulation.
required_dossiers: Form A - Application for Incorporation of an International Company
Executed Constitution (Memorandum and Articles)
Statutory declaration of compliance by the proposed registered agent
Consent of the registered agent and registered office in Samoa
Identity documents of the initial director(s) and shareholder(s)
Proof of payment of the official incorporation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or requisition, the registered agent lodges a curative written response or amended schedule within 7 days; clerical objections are cured by re-submission of corrected forms without a reprocessing penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon due compliance, the Registrar endorses and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company's unique registry number and the date of incorporation. The Certificate is conclusive evidence of incorporation, and the company acquires legal personality as of that date. The registered agent then obtains certified copies, the corporate kit, an optional common seal, share certificates, and the statutory registers of members, directors, and charges.
required_dossiers: Approved incorporation file bearing the Registry stamp
Receipt of payment of the official filing fee
Endorsed Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any clerical error in the Certificate is corrected by written application to the Registrar, who re-issues an amended Certificate and replacement certified copies within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Session: First Board Resolution and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of the newly incorporated International Company, recorded by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial director(s) convene an organizational meeting or sign a circular resolution adopting the First Board Resolution that confirms the subscription of allotted shares, adopts the Constitution, fixes the registered office and registered agent, appoints the initial directors and company secretary, and authorizes the opening of bank and payment-account facilities, including Stripe and PayPal, and the execution of supporting corporate documents. Minutes are signed by the chairperson and retained in the statutory records at the registered office in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the First Board Resolution
Consent to act as director and consent to act as secretary (if any)
Share allotment and subscription schedule
Registered office and registered agent consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an appointment is invalid or a consent is withdrawn, the board passes an ordinary resolution to ratify or replace the appointee and files a Notice of Change of Director with the Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Registers, Tax Status, and Compliance Calibration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent (statutory records); Samoa Ministry of Revenue (tax status); Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (AML onboarding)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Establish the statutory registers of members, directors, secretaries, and charges; issue share certificates; adopt the optional common seal; and file the first annual return within the statutory period. Apply for confirmation of tax-exempt status under the International Business Activities Act 2011, so that offshore income, including e-commerce sales routed through the International Company, is exempt from Samoan income tax, while any physical Samoan-source trading remains taxable. Complete the registered agent's beneficial-ownership and economic substance filings and maintain all records at the registered office in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Statutory registers of members, directors, and charges
Issued share certificates
Tax-exemption confirmation application under the International Business Activities Act 2011
Beneficial ownership and economic substance returns
First annual return
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late-filing penalties for annual returns are cured by prompt submission with a written explanation; the Ministry of Revenue may waive or abate penalties where the default is inadvertent and all fees are settled within 5 business days of discovery.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Business Licences Unit; and Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA) for any future physical premises in Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - a Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 1998 is mandatory only for domestic trading or manufacturing in Samoa; a pure offshore International Company engaged in remote online jewellery and timepiece merchandising is exempt from local industrial licensing

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) - Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category 4, no EIA required) for remote e-commerce with no manufacturing, storage, or construction footprint in Samoa; a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report would be triggered only by establishing physical jewellery production, plating, polishing, or warehousing facilities under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero local discharge for pure online operations. If physical facilities are later commissioned, compliance is required with the wastewater consent regime under the Water Resources Management Act 2008, the Waste Management Act 2005 for hazardous waste handling, VOC and particulate emission limits for precious-metal polishing or plating processes, and the National Environment Standards for ambient air quality.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to a remote operation without local employees. If an Apia office, boutique, or storage facility is opened, prior clearance is required from the Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) for fire safety, the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) for building occupancy and structural load inspection under the Samoa Building Code, and the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour for workplace occupational safety and health clearance of any local staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa (formerly Samoa Revenue Authority) – operational tax and customs administration under the Tax Administration Act 2015; electronic services portal: tax.gov.ws; customs declarations via ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is not automatically issued a TIN. The IC must first be incorporated and licensed by the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA). To obtain a Samoan TIN/VAT ID for any limited domestic fiscal interaction, the IC files the business registration form with the Ministry for Revenue together with the Certificate of Incorporation, the SIFA International Company licence, registered agent details, and certified constitutional documents; a TIN is issued within 5-10 working days. The IC remains outside the normal income tax net and is not required to file Samoan income tax returns while validly licensed.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under Samoan law. The IC tax-exempt status is statutory and automatic under the International Companies Act 1987; the only election is to revoke/convert the entity into a domestic company under the Companies Act 2001, which would trigger full Samoan income tax and VAGST exposure.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 60,000 annual taxable turnover; however, a licensed International Company engaging exclusively in offshore business is exempt from VAGST and is not required to register unless it also makes taxable supplies of goods or services in Samoa.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently mandate real-time fiscal clearance, API-based invoicing, or digital stamping for VAGST. Tax invoices may be issued in paper or secure PDF format and must contain the supplier's TIN, invoice number, date, supplier and recipient details, description of goods, and the VAGST amount shown separately. No government e-invoicing clearance platform is in operational service.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of jewellery and timepieces are zero-rated under the VAGST Act 2008 where the goods are physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply and the supplier retains proof of export. Supplies of offshore services by an International Company to non-residents are outside the scope of Samoan VAGST entirely. Zero-rating is available only to a VAGST-registered supplier; an exempt IC is not entitled to claim input credits.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged via ASYCUDA World to the Samoa Customs Service
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Samoa
Commercial invoice with full description and HS Chapter 71/91 classification of jewellery and timepieces
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign exchange record from a licensed bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue audits zero-rated export claims against ASYCUDA customs records, bank remittance evidence, and transport documents. Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims attract an assessment for the full VAGST evaded plus a minimum evasion penalty of 50% and up to 200% of the tax shortfall, late-payment penalties of 5% per month on outstanding amounts, and criminal liability including fines and imprisonment for directors under the Tax Administration Act 2015. Retrospective clawback extends to all related input credit claims and may disqualify the exporter from future zero-rating privileges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) operates under a managed convertibility framework. Current-account transactions are freely supported through CBS-authorised dealer banks, while capital-account transfers, including shareholder injections and profit remittances, require prior CBS approval or an authorised dealer's exchange-control consent. Profit remittance hurdles include documentary proof of the International Company's tax-exempt status, original financial statements, and confirmation that no tax obligations are outstanding in Samoa. Offshore convertibility of WST is limited; settlement is practically effected through correspondent banks of the local authorised dealer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export receipts from online jewelry and timepiece sales must be repatriated to a CBS-authorised dealer bank within 180 days of shipment unless an exemption is granted for an approved offshore account. The default statutory requirement requires that 100% of the export proceeds be converted into WST at the authorised dealer rate; however, a deviation to retain receipts in USD may be approved if the International Company demonstrates a direct operational need for foreign currency to pay non-resident suppliers and e-commerce platform fees.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BSP Bank Samoa (Bank of South Pacific)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa has no dedicated fintech EMI or payment-institution licensing category; only CBS-licensed commercial banks may perform foreign exchange, money transmission, and customer credit operations. Offshore digital EMIs cannot independently clear WST or hold local settlement accounts, and EU/UK passporting does not extend to Samoa. A foreign EMI may be viable only through a white-label partnership with a local licensed bank acting as sponsor and clearing gateway.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and signatories are generally required to attend an in-person interview at the bank's Apia or overseas branch as part of initial onboarding. Remote opening is not standard for International Companies; however, a fully remote alternative may be accepted on a case-by-case basis through a CBS-authorised digital identity provider, subject to notarised and apostilled corporate due-diligence packs and a live video interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company structure with non-resident directors, nominee shareholders, and no physical operating footprint in Samoa
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act; registered agent Certificate of Good Standing; full directors and shareholders registers; beneficial ownership declaration; issued share capital ledger; notarised and apostilled passport copies; bank reference from the overseas parent or principal shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medium-risk e-commerce luxury goods profile: online jewelry and fashion watches, high unit values, cross-border payment processors Stripe/PayPal, and potential third-party settlement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: AML/CFT compliance manual approved by a designated compliance officer; detailed corporate business plan and website evidence; signed agreements with Stripe and PayPal including merchant onboarding records; source-of-inventory documentation and authorised dealer invoices from luxury wholesalers; end-customer dispute and refund policy; reconciliation of platform payout reports to the bank account; insurance certificates for high-value consignments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injection must be routed via SWIFT MT103 from a recognised overseas bank to the International Company's WST or USD account at a CBS-authorised dealer. The wire narrative must include the IC registration number, the purpose ‘Equity Injection – International Company (ISIC 4791)’, and the invoice/board-resolution reference. The authorised dealer will require a copy of the share allotment resolution, source-of-funds statement, and confirmation from the registered agent that the injected capital has been recorded in the corporate register.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements should use SWIFT MT103 or MT202 for supplier payments and e-commerce platform settlements, alongside documentary commercial letters of credit for large inventory purchases. For LC settlements, the authorised dealer will require a full set of clean-on-board shipping documents, a commercial invoice matching the purchase order, insurance certificate, and inspection certificate for the jewelry and watch consignment. Payment release occurs only after CBS exchange-control approval and negative screening of all counterparties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/WST deliverable forward contracts with a CBS-authorised dealer bank
Currency swaps where both legs are settled through the same authorised dealer in Samoa
FX options with upfront premium settled domestically through a CBS-authorised bank
Offsetting natural hedge structures using USD revenue accounts and USD-denominated supplier accounts without an offshore NDF market

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company (statement of registered office, director(s), member(s) and issued share capital)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Government of Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty accrues under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations; continued default triggers a written default notice from the Registrar and, if un-remedied within the statutory notice period, administrative strike-off and dissolution of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee (renewal levy assessed on authorised share capital; billed in Samoa Tala, shown as indicative USD equivalent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Government of Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due concurrently with the Annual Return, within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary, with no grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late-payment penalty applies to overdue annual fees; non-payment after formal Registrar notice renders the International Company liable to administrative strike-off and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Beneficial-Owner and KYC Refresh (submission of updated UBO confirmation and current statutory registers to the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent as reporting entity under Samoa's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act; records examinable by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the incorporation anniversary, or immediately upon any share transfer or director change during the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Outdated or false beneficial-ownership records constitute an AML/CFT compliance breach attracting administrative fines against the company or agent; agent resignation may follow, causing loss of the mandatory registered agent and subsequent strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a tax-exempt, non-resident International Company under the International Companies Act 2009. A compulsory independent audit arises only if the company holds a regulated banking, insurance or trustee licence, if the Registrar directs audited accounts due to non-compliance, or if the company becomes tax-resident in Samoa and exceeds turnover and record thresholds under the Income Tax Act 2015. The present online fashion-jewellery and timepiece trading entity falls outside all triggers, and no annual corporate income tax return is due from the exempt International Company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Samoa; a non-resident exempt International Company may alternatively apply IFRS or US GAAP consistently, provided accounting records are sufficient to disclose financial position and to support the Annual Return and statutory registers.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa maintains no public beneficial-ownership register. The licensed registered agent must verify and hold current UBO particulars at incorporation, upon any member or shareholding change, and at least annually at the anniversary date. Any share transfer must be recorded forthwith in the Register of Members and reflected in the next Annual Return; no separate UBO filing is made to the Registrar, but the agent's KYC file must evidence the ultimate beneficial owner as part of the annual compliance renewal.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500–1,000 per annum for licensed registered agent, registered office and annual corporate secretarial administration
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for exempt International Company (no audit mandatory); voluntary audit USD 2,500–5,000 per annum; voluntary review or compilation USD 1,200–2,500 per annum

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company holding a valid Tax Exemption Certificate on all foreign-source income; standard domestic Samoan corporate income tax rate of 25% applies only to Samoa-source trading income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate is 0% on cross-border jewelry and watch online retail sales attributable to the International Company. No capital gains tax on foreign-source assets; no Samoan VAT/GST on offshore sales. Sole fiscal charge is the annually renewable International Company government fee, scaled by authorized share capital (approx. US$350 to US$2,000).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IC-AR (International Company Annual Return) together with Schedule B (Nil Income Tax Declaration); filed through the Samoa International Companies Registry (SIRC) secure e-filing portal, with an electronic copy forwarded to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 60 days after each incorporation anniversary; the financial year end of the International Company may be designated on first filing and followed consistently thereafter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered International Company name, unique IC registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact legal name shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; attach a certified copy for verification. Do not use trading aliases.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa registered office address and licensed registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office must be physically located in Samoa and maintained by a licensed agent. Provide no foreign postal addresses in this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reference number and issue date of the Tax Exemption Certificate, plus confirmation that no Samoa-source income has arisen.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners should verify the certificate remains in force. If the entity has engaged in Samoan domestic sales, mark the domestic income declaration box instead.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISIC v4 code and concise business purpose description.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'ISIC 4791 - Online merchandising of fashion jewelry and fine timepieces'. Use only foreign market descriptions; avoid referencing physical delivery to Samoan consumers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name, nationality, residential address, and percentage interest of each registrable beneficial owner or ultimate trust beneficiary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a family trust arrangement, disclose the settlor, protector, and discretionary beneficiaries in a separate confidential Schedule; update within 30 days of any trust deed variation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Substance and Physical Presence Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of premises, employees, board meeting location, and accounting record location in Samoa or through local agent arrangement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If fulfillment, inventory, and servers are outside Samoa, declare the overseas commercial location (e.g., Hong Kong or Singapore) and confirm that there is no permanent establishment in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or authorized registered agent, with date and specimen signatory designation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Corporate directors must be identified by name of the corporate directorship entity; if signed by agent, attach a notarized power of attorney executed by the non-resident beneficial owner.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a fixed penalty of WST 500 and a daily surcharge of WST 50 up to a maximum of WST 5,000. Failure to pay the annual license fee before the due date triggers automatic late fees, interest at 1.5% per month, and possible administrative strike-off from the International Companies Register; reinstatement costs apply.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% withholding tax on dividends and other profit distributions paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders when the company is tax-exempt. Domestic Samoan source dividends paid to resident shareholders are statutorily subject to a 15% dividend withholding tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa maintains limited double tax agreements, principally with Australia and New Zealand. An eligible foreign shareholder claiming treaty relief must apply to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue on Form TRC-01, attaching the latest audited or independently reviewed financial statements, the ICAR filing acknowledgement, and the foreign tax residency certificate issued by the shareholder's home tax authority. The Samoa Ministry of Revenue issues a Tax Residency Certificate for the International Company within 30 working days upon confirmation that the company's management and effective control are in Samoa. Because the International Company is already exempt, treaty relief is normally only required to evidence beneficial ownership in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction or to prevent double taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border royalties and interest paid out of tax-exempt International Company treasury where the IP or loan funding is used offshore. Domestic statutory rates are 15% for interest, 15% for royalties, and 15% for dividends. Under applicable treaty rates with Australia or New Zealand, royalty and interest withholding may be reduced to 0-10%, with domestic limitation rules applying to interest not exceeding arm's length debt-to-equity ratios.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,500,000 (approx. US$580,000) aggregate controlled transactions in a fiscal year; this threshold is not applicable to International Companies that maintain a valid Tax Exemption Certificate and exclusively derive foreign-source income. A domestic taxable entity crossing the threshold must prepare Local File and Master File in accordance with Samoa's Income Tax Act framework.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations 2021, as amended, impose a substance test on International Companies undertaking relevant activities, including 'distribution and service centre' business. Online retailing of fashion jewelry and watches from a Samoa-registered International Company using overseas distribution hubs is characterized as a relevant activity. The IC must demonstrate Samoan economic direction, maintain a physical registered office in Samoa, hold at least one board meeting in Samoa in each financial year, keep adequate accounting records in Samoa or in a form accessible in Samoa, and justify that booking, procurement, and customer contracting decisions have Samoan involvement. A purely passive letterbox arrangement without substance will fail the Economic Substance Regulations test, nullify the exemption, and expose the company to sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion via False Exemption Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring foreign-source status while maintaining persistent sales to Samoa residents, holding inventory in Samoa, employing staff in Apia, or maintaining a payment terminal accepting Samoan Tala. Such activities constitute a Samoan taxable presence and the Income Tax Act deems the profits to be Samoa-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of the Tax Exemption Certificate; full assessment of undeclared profits at 25% corporate income tax; an evasion penalty of 200% of the tax evaded; and an administrative fine of up to WST 500,000. The company may also be struck off the International Companies Register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorized or recklessly allowed the false exemption claim are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of the unpaid tax and penalties. The court may issue a travel ban preventing departure from Samoa, and convicting directors may face imprisonment of up to 14 years under the Crimes Act 2013 on charges of tax fraud or false declaration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating entirely from a foreign office without any Samoan registered agent interaction, with no board meetings, no accounting records accessible in Samoa, and using the Samoa International Company solely as an invoice routing layer for an online jewelry and watch business managed in Hong Kong.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalty of up to WST 250,000 for each non-compliant financial year; in addition, the Registrar may strike off the International Company without prior notice; tax exemption is retroactively forfeited and a corporate fine of WST 100,000 applies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified from serving as directors of any Samoa company for up to 5 years, required to personally refund annual fee savings obtained through the sham arrangement, and subject to a 12-month travel ban pending the outcome of strike-off proceedings. Imprisonment is generally not triggered for substance failure alone, but contempt of a Registrar's production order carries a custodial sentence of up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing high-volume payments for luxury watches through Stripe or PayPal while failing to maintain the Beneficial Ownership Register, concealing the identity of the true trust beneficiary behind a nominee shareholder, or accepting settlement proceeds in digital wallets that obscure the personal financial interest of the client.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to WST 1,000,000 under the Money Laundering and Prevention of Terrorism Financing Act 2021; ordering of forfeiture of the assets or their equivalent value; revocation of the registered agent's license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the appointed compliance officer may be criminally fined up to WST 250,000 individually, issued with travel bans pending investigation, and imprisoned for up to 7 years for money laundering; application of asset freezing orders to personal bank accounts is common in cross-border Swiss and Hong Kong banking investigations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Disguised Profit Repatriation and Transfer Pricing Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring economically unwarranted management fees, inflated royalty payments, or interest-free shareholder loans from the Samoa International Company to a Hong Kong sister company, thereby extracting profits from the online watch retail activity without declaring distributions and without economic justification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer pricing adjustment recharacterizing such payments as dividends; disallowance of all artificial deductions; assessment at the full 25% corporate tax rate on deemed distributions; imposition of penal interest at 6% per annum; and a 15% withholding tax on the recharacterized dividend to the foreign shareholder.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized the sham agreements are liable to repay the amount of the tax adjustment out of their own assets where the company lacks funds, cannot obtain discharge in bankruptcy under Samoan company law, and may be canceled from future directorship positions. In egregious cases where bank records are falsified, directors face imprisonment of up to 10 years for false accounting.
